crossRefs.note: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.
Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.
But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.
Yahweh appeared again in Shiloh; for Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by Yahweh’s word.
We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.
translations.bsb: And the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare, and visions were scarce.
translations.kjv: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.
translations.asv: And the child Samuel ministered unto Jehovah before Eli. And the word of Jehovah was precious in those days; there was no frequent vision.
